attributes.action: MAKE BODY CAMERAS AND RECORDED INTERVIEWS MANDATORY IN CHILD PROTECTION CASES
attributes.additional_details:
We are calling on the UK Government to introduce legislation requiring all social workers involved in child protection investigations and child removal proceedings to use body-worn cameras and ensure that formal interviews involving children and parents are audio or video recorded. 
life-changing decisions are being made about removing children from their families, there should be full transparency and reliable evidence of what was actually said.
